contract: Whether the vendor's own name and logo appear in anything a customer's scheduling sends out must be decided by one resolution of the hide-branding setting — the event's owning entity ORed with its parent organization/team, as `resolveHideBranding` in packages/features/profile/lib/hideBranding.ts defines it — and every producer of attendee-facing content, synchronous page render or deferred automation alike, must read that same resolved value for the same event, so an attendee's message can never disagree with the booking page the customer booked from.

defect_location.summary: The contract is owned by packages/features/profile/lib/hideBranding.ts:35-45, where resolveHideBranding returns true whenever the organization/parent has branding hidden regardless of the entity's own column, and is exposed for events as shouldHideBrandingForEventUsingProfile / shouldHideBrandingForEvent / ...ForTeamEvent / ...ForUserEvent (hideBranding.ts:85-181). Every page the customer books from consumes exactly that: apps/web/server/lib/[user]/[type]/getServerSideProps.ts:299-302, apps/web/lib/team/[slug]/[type]/getServerSideProps.tsx:199-202, apps/web/lib/d/[link]/[slug]/getServerSideProps.tsx:61-64 and :103-106, apps/web/lib/org/[orgSlug]/instant-meeting/team/[slug]/[type]/getServerSideProps.ts:85-88, apps/web/app/(booking-page-wrapper)/team/[slug]/[type]/pageWithCachedData.tsx:36-39, apps/web/modules/bookings/views/bookings-single-view.getServerSideProps.tsx:251-258 and packages/features/ee/payments/pages/payment.tsx:58-63. The automations do not. packages/features/ee/workflows/api/scheduleEmailReminders.ts:246-248, :274-276 and :433-435 compute `brandingDisabled = reminder.booking.eventType?.team ? !!team.hideBranding : !!reminder.booking.user?.hideBranding` — raw columns, with no organization/parent inheritance, and the data to do better is not even selected (packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/getWorkflowReminders.ts:164-207 selects only user.hideBranding and eventType.team.{parentId,hideBranding}, never team.parent.hideBranding nor the owner's profile/organization). That value is then handed to the renderers that stamp the vendor name: templates/emailReminderTemplate.ts:82-85 and templates/emailRatingTemplate.ts:79-82 append `${t("scheduling_by")} ${APP_NAME}` unless isBrandingDisabled, and templates/customTemplate.ts:216-218 appends `Scheduling by ${APP_NAME}` (APP_NAME from packages/lib/constants.ts). The second wrong source is the entity itself: packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/service/EmailWorkflowService.ts:90-93 calls getHideBranding({ userId: workflow.userId, teamId: workflow.teamId }) — the WORKFLOW's owner rather than the booked event's owner/team — and packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/service/WorkflowService.ts:133-136 does the same off the routing form's owner, the value then travelling through reminderScheduler.ts:91-101/155-162/207-253 and emailReminderManager.ts:109-118/143-153 to the send. The booking paths feed the same automation a raw column too: packages/features/bookings/lib/service/RegularBookingService.ts:2618, :2793, :2808, packages/features/bookings/lib/handleConfirmation.ts:459 and :472, packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts:471, packages/features/bookings/lib/handleBookingRequested.ts:112, packages/features/handleMarkNoShow.ts:377, packages/features/ee/round-robin/roundRobinManualReassignment.ts:671, packages/features/ee/managed-event-types/reassignment/services/ManagedEventManualReassignmentService.ts:188 and packages/app-store/_utils/payments/handlePaymentSuccess.ts:230 all pass `!!eventType?.owner?.hideBranding`, which cannot honour an organization setting because packages/features/bookings/lib/handleNewBooking/getEventTypesFromDB.ts:109-113 selects only `owner: { select: { hideBranding: true } }` and ignores the team entirely. Fixing the symptom means resolving branding for the booked event through hideBranding.ts on every automation path and widening the selects (getWorkflowReminders.ts, getEventTypesFromDB.ts) to carry the parent organization and owner profile the resolver needs.
